execution: Explicit manual dispatch with a selected platform. Retired symbolication diagnostic workflows do not dispatch builds. Permanent product symbol ingestion and gates remain unchanged.

recoveryLifecycle.review: Before expiry; accepted evidence and active failure controls must have a verified usable copy before retirement
recoveryLifecycle.retire: After verified replacement or when unfinished work no longer requires it
recoveryLifecycle.migration: Plan bounded storage and verify exact identities/hashes; do not dispatch builds or duplicate full producer bundles to refresh retention

existingArtifacts: Retention changes apply only to future uploads. Existing protected artifact expiry is unchanged.
scope: Retired task qualification and any future disposable diagnostic reports. Normal CI/release and permanent product symbol ingestion/gates are preserved.
